events.title: Copper State Whiskey Festival
events.venueAddress: 2330 W Rio Salado Pkwy, Mesa, AZ 85201
events.description: Arizona's largest whiskey festival takes over Sloan Park, the Chicago Cubs' spring training stadium, for an evening of tastings. The event includes luxury suite access and a dedicated cigar lounge alongside whiskey vendors from around the country.

events.title: Phoenix Pizza Festival
events.time: Sat 11:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sun 11:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: The 11th annual Phoenix Pizza Festival brings local pizza makers together at Hance Park to sell slices, full pies and other pizza inspired creations. The two day event also features live music from local bands, a vendor market and kids activities, with proceeds benefiting Downtown Phoenix, Inc.

events.title: Oak Creek Arts and Crafts Show
events.venueAddress: Bell Rock Plaza, Village of Oak Creek, Sedona, AZ 86351
events.description: This free, open-air show among the red rocks features paintings, photography, pottery, jewelry and Native American art from juried exhibitors, along with gourmet food booths and live music.

events.title: Lee Brice
events.venueName: The Pool at Talking Stick Resort
events.venueAddress: 9800 E Talking Stick Way, Scottsdale, AZ 85256
events.description: Country singer Lee Brice performs a headlining set at The Pool at Talking Stick Resort. Tickets are available through Ticketmaster.

events.title: Brand New
events.description: Rock band Brand New plays Arizona Financial Theatre in downtown Phoenix, part of a run of 2026 tour dates.

events.title: Tails on the Trails: A Dog's Day Out
events.description: The Phoenix Zoo opens its trails to leashed dogs for the first time with this one day event, including a Cool Canine Club splash area and Poses with Paws photo stops. Human admission is the standard ticket price or free for members, and dog passes are limited and sold separately.

events.title: 10th Arizona Bao and Dumpling Festival
events.description: Phoenix Food Festivals brings its 10th Arizona Bao and Dumpling Festival to Centennial Plaza Park behind Peoria City Hall. The free, two day outdoor event features bao, dumplings and noodle vendors alongside live entertainment and a kids area.

events.title: Downtown Phoenix Farmers Market
events.description: Downtown Phoenix Inc hosts its weekly Saturday farmers market at Arizona Center, with local produce, prepared food and craft vendors. The market runs year round in the open air plaza near 3rd Street and Van Buren.

events.title: Run for Mental Health 5K/10K/13.1 Phoenix
events.description: A community road race offering 5K, 10K and half marathon distances benefiting mental health awareness programs. Runners start in waves beginning at 7:30 AM, with a family fun run and virtual option also available.

events.title: Herberger Festival of the Arts
events.description: The Herberger Theater Center hosts its 17th annual Festival of the Arts in downtown Phoenix. The free event runs from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. and features live performances from local dance and music groups alongside a marketplace of art and food vendors.

events.title: Indigenous Arts Fair
events.description: The Arizona-Sonora Desert Museum hosts its annual Indigenous Arts Fair, where Indigenous artists sell handmade jewelry, pottery and paintings while demonstrating their craft. The fair is included with museum admission.

events.title: Country Christmas at the Farm
events.description: Mortimer Farms transforms into a holiday walk with lighted displays, a nativity scene, pony rides and photos with Santa on select dates. The farm market and deli stay open daily through the run, which closes on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals vs. Los Angeles Rams
events.description: The Arizona Cardinals host the Los Angeles Rams in a Week 10 NFL matchup at State Farm Stadium. Kickoff is set for 2:05 PM MST.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. LA Lakers
events.description: The Phoenix Suns close their homestand against the LA Lakers at Footprint Center. Tip-off is scheduled for 2:00 PM.

events.title: phxPRIDE Community Unity 5K
events.description: Phoenix Pride hosts its second annual Community Unity 5K, a run and walk benefiting the Phoenix Pride Community Foundation scholarships, grants and health initiatives. A virtual race option is also offered for those who cannot attend in person.

events.title: Teddy Swims: The UGLY Tour
events.description: Grammy nominated singer Teddy Swims headlines The UGLY Tour at Mortgage Matchup Center, with special guests Natasha Bedingfield and MarcLo. The arena show is part of the singer fall 2026 tour.

events.title: Nick Shoulders: Apocalypse, Never! Tour
events.description: Yodeling country artist Nick Shoulders plays the Orpheum Theater on his Apocalypse, Never! Tour. Doors open at 6:30 PM ahead of the 7:30 PM show.

events.title: Christmas at the Princess
events.description: The Fairmont Scottsdale Princess transforms into a desert winter wonderland with millions of lights, a Christmas tree lagoon show, ice skating and train rides. The event runs nightly from the week before Thanksgiving through early January each year.

events.title: Better Together 2026
events.venueAddress: 300 E Indian School Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85012
events.description: This 18 and up, two day electronic music festival returns to Steele Indian School Park after the 2025 edition was canceled for weather and safety reasons. Relentless Beats, Arizona's flagship EDM promoter, presents the celebration of music, unity and community.

events.title: The Wiz
events.time: Fri 8:00 PM, Sat 2:00 PM and 8:00 PM, Sun 1:00 PM and 7:00 PM
events.venueName: Tom and Janet Ikeda Theater, Mesa Arts Center
events.description: The touring Broadway production of The Wiz plays five performances at Mesa Arts Center's Ikeda Theater as part of the venue's Broadway Series. All-in ticket prices start at $62.50.

events.title: Goodguys 29th Speedway Motors Southwest Nationals
events.time: Fri-Sat 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM
events.description: More than 3,000 hot rods, classic trucks, customs and muscle cars built in 1999 or earlier fill WestWorld of Scottsdale for this three day car show. The weekend includes an autocross competition, a vendor midway and a swap meet.

events.title: Steve Trevino: Comedy Show
events.venueAddress: 9800 E Talking Stick Way, Scottsdale, AZ 85256
events.description: Comedian Steve Trevino brings his stand up act to Talking Stick Resort. Tickets are available through Ticketmaster.

events.title: Outlander in Concert
events.description: A live orchestra performs Bear McCreary's acclaimed score from the Outlander television series at the historic Fox Tucson Theatre, as part of the Echoes Through the Highlands world tour.
events.imageKeyword: live orchestra film score concert theater

events.title: El Tour de Tucson
events.description: The 43rd El Tour de Tucson, one of America's largest charity cycling events, draws thousands of riders to loop courses around Tucson on Saturday, November 21, 2026, with distances for all abilities.

events.title: Dial Up Festival
events.description: This new traveling festival celebrates late 1990s and early 2000s music and culture, with Nelly and Sugar Ray headlining a lineup that also includes Smash Mouth, Alien Ant Farm, Warren G, Paul Wall and Unwritten Law. The single day event runs from early afternoon into the evening with themed bars, vendors and photo ops.

events.title: Howdy Tucson! Music of the American West
events.description: The Tucson Symphony Orchestra opens its Live at the Ronstadt pops series with a program of Western classics, including The Arizona Waltz and music from How the West Was Won and The Magnificent Seven. Conductor Evan Roider leads the orchestra with baritone Nathaniel Hackmann.

events.title: Arizona Indigenous Culinary Experience
events.venueAddress: 12621 N Frank Lloyd Wright Blvd, Scottsdale, AZ 85259
events.description: Held during Native American Heritage Month at Frank Lloyd Wright's Taliesin West, this event pairs curated tasting stations and live culinary demonstrations from Indigenous chefs with a Native fashion showcase. The evening highlights foodways and design traditions from Arizona's Native communities.

events.title: Three Days Grace: Alienation Tour
events.description: Rock band Three Days Grace headlines its Alienation Tour at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre, with support from I Prevail and The Funeral Portrait. The stop is part of a fall 2026 North American arena and amphitheater run.

events.title: Ye (Kanye West): Live in Phoenix
events.description: Ye, formerly known as Kanye West, plays the only Arizona date of his stadium tour supporting the album Bully. It marks his first metro Phoenix concert since 2020.

events.title: Phoenix Spartan Trifecta Weekend
events.description: Phoenix Raceway hosts a full weekend of Spartan obstacle course races, including the Sprint 5K, Super 10K and Beast 21K distances along with a kids race. Racers who complete all three main distances over the weekend earn Trifecta status.

events.title: La Encantada Fine Art Festival
events.description: Art State Arizona presents a two day juried fine art festival in La Encantada's covered garden walkways in the Tucson foothills. Around 50 juried artisans exhibit alongside live demonstrations from the Southern Arizona Artists Guild. Admission is free, Saturday 10am to 5pm and Sunday 11am to 4pm.

events.title: Steep Canyon Rangers
events.description: Grammy winning bluegrass band Steep Canyon Rangers headline the historic Fox Tucson Theatre with support from Eugene Boronow. The band is known for its work with Steve Martin as well as its own string band catalog.

events.title: Kimes Ranch Million Dollar Breakaway
events.description: Billed as the richest breakaway roping in the world, this championship brings 20 qualifying finalists to WestWorld of Scottsdale for 10 evening performances competing for a $1,000,000 purse. The event caps a season of qualifying rodeos held across the country.

events.title: Lake Havasu Festival of Lights
events.venueAddress: 1477 Queens Bay, Lake Havasu City, AZ 86403
events.description: More than 500,000 lights illuminate the historic London Bridge and surrounding English Village for this free holiday season display. Visitors can walk the lakefront path or view the lights by boat along the Bridgewater Channel.

events.title: Katseye: The Wildworld Tour
events.description: Global pop group Katseye brings The Wildworld Tour to downtown Phoenix, their first headline arena run. The show follows the group breakout year with a set built around their chart topping singles.

events.title: ZooLights
events.description: The Phoenix Zoo's annual holiday light show returns with millions of lights across walking trails, plus seasonal food and drink. Tickets are valid for any single night within the run, and dates and hours are subject to change without notice.

events.title: ZooLights presented by SRP
events.description: The Phoenix Zoo transforms into a nighttime holiday light display for its annual ZooLights season, running select evenings from late November through mid-January. General admission is $35, with discounted Member Monday nights on select dates.

events.title: Sedona Turkey Trot 5K
events.description: The 17th annual Sedona Turkey Trot offers a Thanksgiving morning 5K and kids fun run starting and finishing at Posse Grounds Park. Cash prizes go to overall winners, with gift card awards for masters and age group finishers.

events.title: Fountain Hills Thanksgiving Day Parade
events.venueAddress: Avenue of the Fountains, Fountain Hills, AZ 85268
events.description: The Fountain Hills Chamber of Commerce hosts the 42nd annual Thanksgiving Day Parade along the Avenue of the Fountains, themed Happy Birthday America for 2026. The free parade follows the morning Turkey Trot 5K through Fountain Park.

events.title: Glendale Glitters
events.description: Nearly one million holiday lights illuminate 12 blocks of Historic Downtown Glendale's Old Towne and Catlin Court districts, with free weekend performances at Murphy Park. Lights glow nightly from the Friday after Thanksgiving through early January.

events.title: Jonas Brothers: The Burning Up Tour All Over Again
events.description: The Jonas Brothers bring an expanded version of their sold out Burning Up Tour celebration to Desert Diamond Arena, with support from Magnus Ferrell and Deleasa. The stop honors the band catalog spanning two decades.

events.title: Las Noches de las Luminarias
events.description: The Desert Botanical Garden lights its desert trails with thousands of hand-lit luminaria bags for its annual holiday season tradition. The event runs select nights from late November through early January and includes live music and seasonal treats. Advance reservations are required due to limited nightly capacity.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. Dallas Mavericks (NBA Cup)
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the Dallas Mavericks at Footprint Center in an NBA Cup group-play matchup. Tip-off is scheduled for 7:00 PM.

events.title: Jay Leno Live
events.venueAddress: 9800 E Talking Stick Way, Scottsdale, AZ 85256
events.description: Comedian and former Tonight Show host Jay Leno performs a stand up set at Talking Stick Resort. Tickets are available through Ticketmaster.

events.title: Territorial Cup: Arizona vs. Arizona State
events.venueAddress: 1 N National Championship Dr, Tucson, AZ 85719
events.description: Arizona and Arizona State close the regular season with the Territorial Cup rivalry game at Arizona Stadium. The annual matchup is one of the oldest rivalry trophies in college football.

events.title: Bluey's Big Play
events.description: The hit stage adaptation of the Emmy winning animated series brings Bluey, Bingo, Bandit and Chilli to life for an interactive family show. The touring production stops in Phoenix for two days with multiple performances.

events.title: Scottsdazzle
events.description: Scottsdazzle is Scottsdale official holiday celebration, filling Old Town with seasonal lights, decorations and a lineup of free community events through New Year. The season includes the Scottsdale Waterfront tree lighting, Merry Main Street window art and holiday shopping and dining throughout the district.

events.title: Banda MS: Somos MS Tour
events.description: Regional Mexican band Banda MS performs as part of the Somos MS Tour at Mortgage Matchup Center in downtown Phoenix.

events.title: The Fab Four: Tribute to the Beatles
events.description: The Fab Four recreate the look and sound of the Beatles across their career, from the Hard Day's Night era through the band's later hits. The tribute show is a regular stop on the group's national touring schedule.

events.title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock LIVE
events.venueName: Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts
events.description: Jim Henson's Creature Shop brings a live stage adaptation of Fraggle Rock to Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts, featuring walk around Fraggle puppets, Doozers and a giant Gorg. The family friendly show appeals to both longtime fans and viewers of the newer Apple TV Plus series.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals vs. Washington Commanders
events.description: The Arizona Cardinals host the Washington Commanders in a Week 12 NFL matchup at State Farm Stadium. Kickoff is scheduled for 2:25 PM, with the game broadcast on FOX.

events.title: Ashley McBryde
events.description: Grammy nominated country singer-songwriter Ashley McBryde performs at the historic Fox Tucson Theatre. Known for her raw, narrative songwriting, McBryde has built her career on albums like Girl Going Nowhere and Never Will.

events.title: The Neighbourhood: Wourld Tour
events.description: Alternative rock band The Neighbourhood brings its Wourld Tour to Mortgage Matchup Center in support of the album Ultrasound, the group first release since a 2022 to 2025 hiatus. Nessa Barrett opens the show.

events.title: Rush: Fifty Something
events.description: Rush performs at Desert Diamond Arena as part of the Fifty Something tour marking five decades since the band formed. A second Glendale date follows on December 3, 2026.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. LA Clippers
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the LA Clippers at Footprint Center. Tip-off is scheduled for 9:00 PM.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. Sacramento Kings
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the Sacramento Kings at Footprint Center. Tip-off is scheduled for 7:00 PM.

events.title: A Night to Toast
events.description: Hotel Valley Ho kicks off the holiday season with a three course dinner paired with Perrier-Jouet Champagnes. The evening opens with a reception in the Citrus Grove before guests move to the Sands venue for dinner.

events.title: RUSH: Fifty Something
events.description: Rush adds a second Glendale date to the Fifty Something tour after their December 1 show, marking five decades since the band formed. The arena previously hosted the band first night on this tour stop.

events.title: Tempe Fall Festival of the Arts
events.description: This three-day street fair fills Mill Avenue with more than 300 juried artist booths spanning ceramics, jewelry, photography, and woodwork. The festival, a past Pinnacle Award winner from the International Festival and Events Association, also features live music, a kids' activity block, and a chalk art competition.

events.title: Holiday Artist Market
events.time: Fri 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM (opening reception), Sat 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Sun 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM
events.description: The Sedona Arts Center hosts about 25 artists and makers from Sedona and around Arizona for this annual holiday market. The juried show features ceramics, jewelry, paintings and textiles, opening with a Friday evening reception.

events.title: Luminaria Nights
events.description: The historic art village of Tubac lines its streets and galleries with luminarias for a two night holiday walk on the first Friday and Saturday of December. Shops and studios stay open late with local vendors and seasonal activities throughout downtown.

events.title: Tlaquepaque Christmas Tree Lighting and Santa Visit
events.description: Tlaquepaque kicks off the holiday season with a tree lighting ceremony, a Santa photo visit, hot chocolate and local holiday entertainment. Admission is free.

events.title: Tempe Festival of the Arts: Fall Edition
events.time: Fri-Sat 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: The 58th annual Tempe Festival of the Arts fills Mill Avenue in downtown Tempe with juried artists, craftspeople and live entertainment. The free, three day event is cash free and includes food vendors alongside the art booths.

events.title: Holiday Pops Spectacular
events.time: Fri 7:30 PM, Sat 2:00 PM and 7:30 PM, Sun 2:00 PM
events.description: The Phoenix Symphony kicks off the holiday season with its annual Holiday Pops Spectacular at Symphony Hall, led by guest conductor Daniel Wiley with the Phoenix Symphony Chorus. The roughly two hour and fifteen minute program runs across four performances over the weekend.

events.title: Sedona Tree Lighting and Santa Visit
events.description: Tlaquepaque North hosts Sedona's community tree lighting with a visit from Santa. The free evening event kicks off the village's holiday season.

events.title: Celebrate Sedona! and Holiday Market
events.time: Opening reception Fri 4:00 PM - 6:00 PM, market continues through Sunday
events.description: The Sedona Arts Center opens its annual Holiday Market with a Celebrate Sedona reception in its upper parking lot, bringing together dozens of regional artists and makers. The market runs through the weekend.

events.title: Tempe Festival of the Arts (Fall)
events.time: Fri-Sat 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: The 58th annual Tempe Festival of the Arts fills historic Mill Avenue with roughly 325 juried artists from across North America, alongside food vendors and live entertainment. Admission is free.

events.title: Downtown Parade of Lights
events.description: Downtown Tucson lights up for its annual holiday parade, with a festival and entertainment at Jacome Plaza before illuminated floats move through the El Presidio neighborhood. The event is presented by Rio Nuevo as part of the city winter holiday celebrations.

events.title: Prescott Christmas Parade & Courthouse Lighting
events.time: Parade 1:00 PM, Courthouse Lighting 5:00 PM with fireworks
events.description: Prescott's 44th annual Christmas Parade winds through downtown before the 72nd annual Courthouse Lighting ceremony illuminates the Yavapai County Courthouse Plaza that evening, capped with a fireworks display. Both events are free and mark the traditional kickoff to Prescott's Christmas City season.

events.title: Casa Grande Electric Light Parade
events.time: Glow Before the Show 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM, parade kickoff 5:45 PM
events.description: Casa Grande's Electric Light Parade sends illuminated floats down Florence Boulevard as part of a citywide holiday celebration that starts earlier that afternoon with family activities at Peart Park. The parade is free to attend and is livestreamed for those who cannot attend in person.

events.title: Stroll in the Glow
events.venueAddress: Avenue of the Fountains, Fountain Hills, AZ 85268
events.description: The Fountain Hills Chamber of Commerce's 37th annual Stroll in the Glow lights the Avenue of the Fountains and the town Christmas tree around 5:45 PM. Santa arrives by fire truck for free photos, and hot air balloons glow over Fountain Park from 6:00 to 8:00 PM.

events.title: AJ McLean presents Alexander James: The Better Man Tour
events.description: Backstreet Boys member AJ McLean performs songs from his solo project Alexander James at the historic Fox Tucson Theatre. The show spans his solo catalog, including material from his 2010 debut album Have It All.

events.title: Breakfast with Santa in Sedona
events.venueName: The HUB at Posse Grounds Park
events.description: A free, family friendly holiday breakfast event with a visit from Santa at Posse Grounds Park. The City of Sedona Parks and Recreation Department hosts the gathering each December.

events.title: Marana Holiday Festival & Christmas Tree Lighting
events.time: 2:00 PM - 9:00 PM (tree lighting 6:00 PM, encore 8:30 PM)
events.venueAddress: 11555 W Civic Center Dr, Marana, AZ 85653
events.description: The Town of Marana's free annual holiday festival features a 45-foot Christmas tree with 100,000 RGB lights, billed as the largest municipal tree in Arizona, plus photos with Santa, a Mistletoe Market of local artisans, food trucks and a holiday train.

events.title: Frontier Holiday Celebration
events.venueName: Presidio San Agustin del Tucson Museum
events.description: The Tucson Presidio Museum hosts its annual Frontier Holiday Celebration with historic demonstrations, family crafts, and musket and cannon firings. This year's event joins Carrillo K-5 Magnet School in celebrating the 90th anniversary of its Las Posadas tradition.

events.title: APS Electric Light Parade
events.venueAddress: Central Ave & Montebello Ave, Phoenix, AZ 85013
events.description: The 39th annual APS Electric Light Parade, themed Power the City with Lights, runs along Central Avenue from Montebello Avenue to 7th Street and Indian School Road. The free community parade features illuminated floats and is one of Phoenix longest running holiday traditions.

events.title: Mesa Night Market
events.description: The AZ International Marketplace hosts an evening night market centered on Asian food vendors and a local artisan marketplace. The market runs from 4 to 9 p.m. with free parking on site.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals vs. Philadelphia Eagles
events.description: The Cardinals welcome the Philadelphia Eagles to State Farm Stadium for a Week 13 NFL regular season matchup. Kickoff is scheduled for 2:05 PM, with the game broadcast on FOX.

events.title: Trans-Siberian Orchestra: Ghosts of Christmas Eve
events.description: Trans-Siberian Orchestra brings its Ghosts of Christmas Eve holiday rock production to downtown Phoenix with matinee and evening performances. Doors open 60 minutes before each scheduled start time.

events.title: Celtic Woman: Silver Bells Christmas Tour
events.venueName: Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts
events.description: Irish vocal group Celtic Woman brings its Silver Bells Christmas Tour to the Virginia G. Piper Theater, blending traditional Celtic music with holiday favorites. The show is part of Scottsdale Center's 2026-27 season.

events.title: Celtic Woman: Silver Bells Christmas Tour 2026
events.venueName: Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts
events.description: Irish vocal group Celtic Woman brings its Silver Bells Christmas Tour to Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts, mixing holiday standards with the group's signature arrangements.

events.title: Scott Bradlee's Postmodern Jukebox: The Future Is Vintage World Tour
events.description: Scott Bradlee's Postmodern Jukebox brings its vintage-style reinventions of modern pop hits to the historic Rialto Theatre. The reserved-seating show has no opening act.

events.title: A Winter's Eve with David Arkenstone & Friends
events.venueAddress: 995 Upper Red Rock Loop Rd, Sedona, AZ 86336
events.description: New age composer David Arkenstone brings his holiday program A Winter's Eve to the Sedona Performing Arts Center. The show features seasonal and original instrumental music.

events.title: Fourth Avenue Winter Street Fair
events.time: Fri-Sat 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: The 57th annual Fourth Avenue Winter Street Fair brings more than 350 artists from around the world to Tucson historic Fourth Avenue district, alongside live entertainment and food vendors. The free three day fair is one of the top rated community celebrations in the Southwest.

events.title: Alt-AZ 93.3 Presents: Ugly Sweater Holiday Party with Sublime, Slightly Stoopid and Codefendants
events.description: Alt-AZ 93.3 hosts a holiday themed concert headlined by Sublime, with support from Slightly Stoopid and Codefendants. The show blends ska and reggae rock with a festive ugly sweater theme.

events.title: Acker Night Musical Showcase
events.time: Opening ceremony 5:00 PM, showcase 5:30 PM - 8:30 PM
events.description: Acker Night is a free walking musical showcase held throughout historic downtown Prescott, with local and touring musicians performing inside shops, galleries, and restaurants along the route. Now in its 38th year, the event benefits the Acker Musical Scholarship Foundation.

events.title: Sam Barber: The American Route Tour
events.description: Singer-songwriter Sam Barber brings his American Route Tour to Arizona Financial Theatre, with support from Josiah and the Bonnevilles and Wild Horses. Doors open at 7:00 PM.

events.title: A Winter's Eve with David Arkenstone and Friends
events.description: Grammy-nominated composer David Arkenstone performs an evening of new age and holiday music with guest Drew Ryn at MIM's Music Theater. Tickets range from about 44.50 to 54.50 dollars.

events.title: A Winter's Eve with David Arkenstone & Friends
events.description: New age composer David Arkenstone performs his holiday program A Winter's Eve at the Musical Instrument Museum's concert hall, part of a short run of Arizona tour dates.

events.title: Alice Cooper's Christmas Pudding
events.description: Alice Cooper hosts his annual Christmas Pudding benefit concert at Celebrity Theatre, joined this year by Dee Snider, Lzzy Hale and Joe Hottinger of Halestorm, John 5 and the Creatures, and Sixwire. Proceeds support music, art and dance programs at Solid Rock Teen Centers.

events.title: Christmas in the Park
events.venueAddress: 279 N La Loma Ave, Litchfield Park, AZ 85340
events.description: Litchfield Park's annual Christmas in the Park festival features a hometown holiday parade followed by a full day of vendor booths, live stage performances, and children's activities in Litchfield Square Park. More than 60 vendors sell gifts, art, and holiday treats at this free, family oriented event.

events.title: Lake Havasu Parade of Lights
events.venueAddress: 422 English Village, Lake Havasu City, AZ 86403
events.description: Decorated boats parade through the Bridgewater Channel beneath the London Bridge for Lake Havasu City's annual Parade of Lights, part of the city's broader Festival of Lights celebration. The free event follows the Dock Glow at London Bridge Resort the night before and draws large crowds along the waterfront walkway.

events.title: Merry Music at the Museum
events.description: A free holiday concert at the Sedona Heritage Museum featuring Acapella Sedona, Verde Valley Voices, and a community singalong. The event is part of the museum's seasonal programming.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. Minnesota Timberwolves
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the Minnesota Timberwolves at Footprint Center. Tip-off is scheduled for 9:00 PM.

events.title: Family Holiday Festival at The Scottsdale Resort & Spa
events.venueName: The Scottsdale Resort & Spa, Curio Collection by Hilton
events.description: A free, family friendly holiday festival on the resort’s Community Lawn with live holiday music, kids crafts, face painting, cookie decorating, a Santa appearance, and local vendors. The evening closes with an outdoor screening of The Grinch.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. Atlanta Hawks
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the Atlanta Hawks at Footprint Center. Tip-off is scheduled for 7:00 PM.

events.title: Beartooth: Pure Ecstasy World Tour
events.description: Metalcore band Beartooth headlines its Pure Ecstasy World Tour at Arizona Financial Theatre, with support from Don Broco, Magnolia Park and Windwaker.

events.title: Sonoran Sunset Series: What's Left
events.venueAddress: 4050 E Chandler Heights Rd, Chandler, AZ 85249
events.description: The City of Chandler's free outdoor concert series continues with local band What's Left performing a mix of holiday tunes and modern hits. Seating is first come, first served, and guests typically bring blankets or lawn chairs.

events.title: The Phoenix Symphony: Holiday Baroque
events.description: The Phoenix Symphony performs a holiday program of Baroque era music at the historic Orpheum Theatre, conducted by Gary Thor Wedow. The approximately two hour fifteen minute concert runs three performances.

events.title: Phoenix Symphony: Holiday Baroque
events.description: The Phoenix Symphony performs a program of Baroque era holiday music at the historic Orpheum Theatre. The run includes three performances: Friday and Saturday evenings and a Sunday matinee.

events.title: Mariachi Sol de Mexico: Merry-achi Christmas
events.venueName: Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts
events.description: Mariachi Sol de Mexico, led by Jose Hernandez, performs its Merry-achi Christmas program of holiday favorites with a mariachi twist at Scottsdale Center for the Performing Arts.

events.title: Handel's Messiah
events.description: The Tucson Symphony Orchestra and TSO Chorus perform Handel Messiah under conductor Patrick Dupre Quigley, with featured vocal soloists. The holiday tradition runs for two afternoon performances.

events.title: Pentatonix: Christmas in the City Tour
events.description: A cappella group Pentatonix brings its Christmas in the City Tour to Desert Diamond Arena, performing holiday classics and original arrangements. The Grammy winning group tours arenas nationwide each December.

events.title: Holiday Sweet Stroll at Tlaquepaque
events.description: Tlaquepaque’s courtyards fill with holiday shopping, sweet treats, and seasonal strolling entertainment. Admission is free and the village’s shops and galleries stay open late for the evening.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals vs. New York Jets
events.description: The Arizona Cardinals host the New York Jets in a Week 15 home game at State Farm Stadium, part of the team's Inspire Change / Walter Payton Man of the Year themed game.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. Indiana Pacers
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the Indiana Pacers at Footprint Center. Tip-off is scheduled for 9:00 PM.

events.title: Matt Rife: Stay Golden World Tour, Live in the Round
events.description: Comedian Matt Rife performs stand-up in the round over two nights at Mortgage Matchup Center as part of his Stay Golden World Tour. The in the round staging places the comedian at the center of the arena floor.

events.title: Arizona National Livestock Show
events.description: The Arizona National Livestock Show brings cattle, sheep, goat and swine exhibitors from across the country to the Arizona State Fairgrounds for five days of judging and competition. The show, an annual Phoenix tradition since 1948, is free to attend.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. Golden State Warriors
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the Golden State Warriors at Footprint Center. Tip-off is scheduled for 7:00 PM.

events.title: Vrbo Fiesta Bowl - College Football Playoff Quarterfinal
events.description: The Vrbo Fiesta Bowl hosts a College Football Playoff quarterfinal at State Farm Stadium on December 30, 2026, the only CFP game played that day, giving Arizona an exclusive national spotlight.

events.title: Decadence Arizona: Sands of Eternity
events.description: The Southwest largest New Year electronic dance music festival returns to Phoenix Raceway for two nights, presented by Relentless Beats. The 2026 Sands of Eternity edition features headliners including Chris Lake, Slander and KETTAMA across multiple stages, and is 18 and up.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. Philadelphia 76ers
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the Philadelphia 76ers at Footprint Center. Tip-off is scheduled for 7:00 PM.

events.title: Decadence Arizona 2026: Sands of Eternity
events.time: Gates and set times vary by day
events.description: Relentless Beats' two day New Year's Eve electronic music festival returns to Phoenix Raceway with the theme Sands of Eternity, headlined by a lineup including Chris Lake, Eli Brown and Slander.

events.title: New Year's Eve Whiskey Row Boot Drop
events.time: 7:00 PM - Midnight, boot drops at 10:00 PM and Midnight
events.description: A six foot illuminated cowboy boot drops twice, at 10 PM and midnight, from the Palace building flagpole to ring in the new year on historic Whiskey Row. The free 16th annual celebration includes live music, food trucks, carnival games and fireworks at both drops.
events.imageKeyword: new years eve street celebration fireworks

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs. New York Knicks
events.description: The Phoenix Suns host the New York Knicks in a New Year's Eve matchup at Mortgage Matchup Center. The game is one of the nationally featured contests on the Suns' 2026-27 regular season schedule.

events.title: Arizona Cardinals vs. Las Vegas Raiders
events.description: The Cardinals host the Las Vegas Raiders in a Week 17 matchup at State Farm Stadium, broadcast on CBS. It is one of the final home games of Arizona's 2026 regular season.

events.title: Arizona Balloon Classic
events.time: Fri 4:00 PM - 9:00 PM, Sat-Sun 7:00 AM - 9:00 PM
events.description: The Arizona Balloon Classic brings morning hot air balloon ascensions and evening balloon glows to Wild Horse Pass Festival Grounds. The weekend also includes the Street FoodFest with food vendors and live entertainment.

events.title: Tucson Jazz Festival
events.description: The Tucson Jazz Festival brings two weeks of performances to downtown venues including the Fox Tucson Theatre, Rialto Theatre and the Century Room. The lineup spans swing, Latin and fusion jazz alongside a free outdoor Downtown Jazz Fiesta.

events.title: 8123 Fest
events.time: Times vary, side events run Jan 14-18
events.description: Pop rock band The Maine headlines its hometown festival for a 20th anniversary celebration, with a different set each night. The 2027 lineup includes The Band Camino, Andrew McMahon and The Aces, alongside side events in Downtown Mesa.

events.title: Rock 'n' Roll Running Series Arizona
events.description: Thousands of runners take on the marathon, half marathon, 10K and 5K with live bands lining courses through Phoenix and Tempe. The marathon runs Sunday, January 17, 2027, finishing near ASU in Tempe.

events.title: Quartzsite Sports, Vacation & RV Show
events.description: Known simply as The Big Tent, this nine-day show is the centerpiece of Quartzsite's massive winter RV gathering, with hundreds of vendors serving the hundreds of thousands of RVers who descend on the desert town each January.

events.title: Celebration of Fine Art
events.venueAddress: Southwest corner of Hayden Road and Mayo Boulevard, Scottsdale, AZ 85258
events.description: Celebration of Fine Art is a working artist exhibition held daily under a series of large white tents in north Scottsdale. Visitors can watch more than 100 painters, sculptors, glass artists and photographers create original work on site and purchase directly from the artists. The show runs for over two months, from mid January through late March.

events.title: Havasu Balloon Festival and Fair
events.venueAddress: 699 London Bridge Rd, Lake Havasu City, AZ 86403
events.description: Dozens of hot air balloons fill the sky over Lake Havasu during this four-day festival featuring mass ascensions, evening balloon glows, a carnival, vendors and live entertainment near the London Bridge.

events.title: Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale Collector Car Auction
events.description: The World's Greatest Collector Car Auction returns to WestWorld of Scottsdale January 23-31, 2027, with more than a thousand collector cars crossing the block plus exhibits, thrill rides and automotive lifestyle displays.

events.title: Gem and Jam Festival
events.description: Gem and Jam Festival pairs a three day electronic and jam music lineup with a gem, mineral and art market at the Pima County Fairgrounds. The festival runs alongside the Tucson Gem and Mineral Show each February.

events.title: Arizona Renaissance Festival
events.venueAddress: 12601 E US Highway 60, Gold Canyon, AZ 85118
events.description: A 16th-century European village springs to life east of Apache Junction with jousting knights, artisan shops, 13 stages of entertainment and giant turkey legs. Open weekends February 6 through April 4, 2027, plus Presidents' Day Monday.

events.title: Arizona Indian Festival
events.time: Sat 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: The Arizona American Indian Tourism Association closes out Scottsdale's Western Week with this free festival of Native American dance, music, arts and food. Arizona tribes participate in cultural demonstrations and vendor booths at the Civic Center.

events.title: WM Phoenix Open
events.description: The Greatest Show on Grass brings the PGA TOUR and the world's rowdiest golf hole, the stadium-seated 16th, to TPC Scottsdale February 8-14, 2027, with tournament rounds Thursday through Sunday.

events.title: Tucson Gem & Mineral Show
events.description: The flagship show of the world-famous Tucson Gem, Mineral & Fossil Showcase runs February 11-14, 2027 at the Tucson Convention Center, capping weeks of citywide gem shows that begin in late January.

events.title: Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show
events.description: Nearly 2,400 of the world's finest Arabian horses compete over 11 days at WestWorld in this signature Scottsdale event, which also features shopping expos, demonstrations and family activities.

events.title: Wickenburg Gold Rush Days & Senior Pro Rodeo
events.description: Wickenburg's 77th annual Gold Rush Days celebrates the town's mining heritage with a senior pro rodeo, parade, carnival, gold panning and artisan fair over Presidents' Day weekend.

events.title: Cactus League Opening Day: Diamondbacks vs. Rockies
events.venueName: Salt River Fields at Talking Stick
events.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks open the 2027 Cactus League spring training season with a split squad game against the Colorado Rockies at their shared spring training home, Salt River Fields at Talking Stick. It is one of eight games across the Cactus League on opening day.

events.title: Cactus League Spring Training
events.description: Fifteen MLB teams, including the Diamondbacks, Cubs and Dodgers, play spring training baseball at ten ballparks around the Valley. Games traditionally begin the third weekend of February and run through late March; the official 2027 schedule is released in fall 2026.

events.title: Tucson Rodeo - La Fiesta de los Vaqueros
events.description: One of the top 25 professional rodeos in North America, La Fiesta de los Vaqueros runs February 20-28, 2027 and includes the Tucson Rodeo Parade, billed as the world's longest non-motorized parade, on February 25.

events.title: Sedona International Film Festival
events.description: The 33rd annual Sedona International Film Festival screens features, documentaries, shorts and animated films over nine days at venues around Sedona, including the Mary D. Fisher Theatre and the Alice Gill-Sheldon Theatre. Many filmmakers attend in person for post-screening discussions.

events.title: Innings Festival
events.venueAddress: 80 W Rio Salado Pkwy, Tempe, AZ 85281
events.description: This baseball-meets-music festival returns to Tempe Beach Park February 26-28, 2027 with three stages of rock, pop and indie acts plus MLB player appearances, timed to the start of spring training.

events.title: Lost Dutchman Days Rodeo & Carnival
events.venueAddress: 1590 E Lost Dutchman Blvd, Apache Junction, AZ 85119
events.description: Apache Junction's signature celebration beneath the Superstition Mountains features three days of pro rodeo, a 30-ride carnival and a downtown parade on Saturday morning, February 27.

events.title: Devour Culinary Classic
events.description: Devour Culinary Classic returns to the Desert Botanical Garden for a weekend of tastings from Arizona restaurants, wineries, breweries and artisan food producers. The event is presented by Local First Arizona and set among the garden's desert landscape.

events.title: Arizona Diamondbacks at Chicago White Sox (Spring Training)
events.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks travel to Camelback Ranch-Glendale for a Cactus League spring training matchup against the Chicago White Sox. First pitch time will be announced closer to the 2027 season.

events.title: Heard Museum Guild Indian Fair & Market
events.time: Sat 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun 9:30 AM - 4:00 PM
events.description: The 69th annual Indian Fair & Market gathers hundreds of the nation's most acclaimed American Indian artists at the Heard Museum, with juried art, music, dance performances and Native foods.

events.title: Desert Bluegrass Festival
events.venueAddress: 12205 N Tangerine Farms Rd, Marana, AZ 85653
events.description: The Desert Bluegrass Festival brings three days of live bluegrass music to Gladden Farms Community Park in Marana. The family friendly event includes workshops, a band scramble, kids' activities, craft vendors and food trucks, with tent and RV camping available on site.

events.title: Tempe Spring Festival of the Arts
events.description: The 50th Spring Tempe Festival of the Arts fills Mill Avenue in downtown Tempe with juried fine art, craft vendors, live entertainment and food booths. The three day outdoor festival draws artists and shoppers from across the Valley to one of Arizona's longest running arts events.

events.title: Tucson Festival of Books
events.description: One of the largest free book festivals in the country returns to the University of Arizona campus with author panels, a science exposition, food trucks and children's activities. The two day event draws well over 100,000 attendees each year.

events.title: TENWEST Festival
events.description: TENWEST is the largest entrepreneurship and creativity festival in the Southwest, hosted by Startup Tucson across venues throughout downtown Tucson. Founders, creators, innovators and community builders gather for talks, workshops and networking. The 2027 edition includes a new title sponsorship from Vantage West Credit Union.

events.title: Arizona Diamondbacks Home Opener vs. Miami Marlins
events.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks open their 2027 home schedule at Chase Field against the Miami Marlins, kicking off a six game homestand that continues with the Los Angeles Dodgers. The game follows a season opening road trip to San Diego, with first pitch time not yet announced.

events.title: Country Thunder Arizona 2027
events.venueAddress: 20585 E Price Station Rd, Florence, AZ 85132
events.description: Country Thunder Arizona returns to Canyon Moon Ranch in Florence for four days of country music, camping and Southwest desert atmosphere. Headliners and full lineup are announced ahead of the event, with reserved seating, general admission and camping packages available.

events.title: Tucson International Mariachi Conference
events.description: The 45th Tucson International Mariachi Conference brings together mariachi and folklorico performers from across the Southwest and Mexico for a week of workshops, youth showcases and concerts. The event culminates in a headline Espectacular concert featuring nationally known mariachi acts.

events.title: The Pineapple Thief: Far and Wide Tour
events.description: British progressive rock band The Pineapple Thief brings its Far and Wide Tour to Crescent Ballroom in downtown Phoenix. The show is a 21 and up, general admission concert presented by Psyko Steve.

events.title: Holiday Baroque
events.time: Fri and Sat 7:30 PM, Sun 2:00 PM
events.description: The Phoenix Symphony performs its Holiday Baroque special series at the Orpheum Theatre, featuring soprano Vanessa Becerra and harpsichordist Elliott Figg. The program runs for three performances across the weekend before Christmas.
